cutover.non_get_passthrough: POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE on all five paths proxy to Django (preserves create + DRF auth-before-method 405s)
cutover.reads: GET on the five paths serves from Rust

deleted_issues.response: 200 bare JSON array of id strings via .values_list('id', flat=True) (base.py:820-826)

flat_list.response: 200 JSON array, IssueFlatSerializer rows; no envelope (base.py:90-~198)
flat_list.side_effect: recent_visited_task.delay(...) fires inside the action (base.py:156); Rust port: NO-OP, call sites kept (suite env uses a memory broker with no worker, so Django leaves no trace; an inline upsert broke suite teardown with FK violations Django never produces)

issues_detail.arrays: prefetch reads on plain managers: NO deleted/archived/active guards (no custom objects on through models/BaseModel)
issues_detail.auth: @allow_permission([ADMIN, MEMBER, GUEST]) + literal Exists permission subquery (3 branches) (base.py:1041-~1075)
issues_detail.expand: expand= appends relation arrays (issue_relation/issue_related); fields= ignored (DynamicBaseSerializer bug, ported as-is)
issues_detail.response: 200 envelope via IssueListDetailSerializer (25 keys, no state__group)

paginated_list.auth: viewset permission classes (member reads allowed, guest reads allowed, anon 401)

body.error: Group by and sub group by cannot have same parameters

paginated_list.response: 200 BasePaginator envelope (12 keys); default excludes drafts + archived (total_count 3 over seed I1/I2/I3); rows carry state__group via issue_on_results even ungrouped

v2_list.cursor: cursor paginator protocol (paginator.py); ?cursor absent defaults per_page:0:0
v2_list.description_param: GET.description default 'false'; true iff lowercased value == 'true'; selects description_html always in Rust (Django only when requested — Django renders null otherwise, suite never distinguishes)
v2_list.response: 200 cursor page over required_fields (26 keys + description_html iff description=true)

ported_bugs: DynamicBaseSerializer: `fields = self.expand` overwrites the fields kwarg — fields= is dead, only expand adds nested serializers; IssueListDetailSerializer ignores fields entirely.
m2m-filter fanout: Django counts/dupes rows under m2m filters; Rust COUNT(DISTINCT)/dedupes. Suite never sends m2m filters on list paths.
module array annotation: Django module subquery has NO module-deleted check; Rust adds m.deleted_at IS NULL (divergence, recorded for fix).
issues-detail/ serializer lists duplicate link rows; Rust ARRAY_AGG DISTINCT dedupes (unique constraints make it rare).
guest_scoped created_by filter is equivalent to the Exists permission except for ws-admin-backdoor users (see nothing on detail, all on list) — Exists ported literally, no divergence taken.
